adoption_rule.text: Propose the nested model as T011's compressed family if, averaged over the three seeds, (a) its width-1.0 mean macro-F1 over the five loss K is at least D026's minus 0.01 and (b) its width-0.5 mean (29% fewer FLOPs per frame) is at least D026's minus 0.02. The full width × K grid is reported either way.

config.batchnorm: frozen; conv3 BN statistics per width, recalibrated on train calibration rows before training and before every validation
config.init: D026 checkpoint, channels reordered by the chosen importance
config.loss: per width: mean over loss_ks of (1-α)·BCE(label) + α·τ²·BCE(σ(student/τ), σ(teacher/τ))

modes.nested: sandwich rule: widths 1.0 and 0.25 every step plus one of 0.75/0.5 at random (seeded); loss averaged over the step's widths

selection.nested: validation macro-F1 at 0.5 averaged over the 4 widths × 5 loss_ks
selection.single: validation macro-F1 at 0.5 averaged over the 5 loss_ks at width 0.5
selection.ties: lower mean BCE, then earlier epoch; epoch 0 not selectable

config.teacher: frozen D026 (F004 family), same frames and flips
